title: Graph Valid Tree
summary: Decide whether n nodes and a list of undirected edges form a single tree: connected, with no cycles.

tests.explain: Four edges for five nodes, no cycle, and every node is reachable from 0: a tree.
1-2-3-1 is a cycle, so this is not a tree (it also has 5 edges, one too many).
Three edges is the right count for four nodes, but they form a triangle and node 3 is left on its own.

hints: A tree on n nodes is connected and has no cycle. Those two facts together mean it has exactly n - 1 edges.
Check the edge count first: anything other than n - 1 edges can't be a tree.
Then union the edges one by one. If union(a, b) finds that a and b already share a root, the edge closes a cycle. With n - 1 edges and no cycle, the graph is automatically connected.

complexity.time: O(n · α(n)): at most n - 1 unions, each almost O(1)
